shared_elements: upright decorated surface divided into zones/registers
justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces present a tall field filled with schematic, repeated symbolic motifs, including stylized creature-like forms and patterned bands or borders. The biggest difference is that A is organized mainly as horizontal registers with profile animals/birds and geometric bands, while B is dominated by a vertical stack of enclosed face-like/cartouche motifs with an ornate side border.
